title: Show HN: I built a little browser game to practice Vim commands
summary: I made hjkl to help myself remember Vim commands. It’s a little browser game you can play when you want to unwind and get a bit of Vim practice in. There are still a lot of commands I want to add, but I hope someone finds it useful in the meantime :) Comments URL: https://news.yc
